provenance.note: Curated compilation of restoration programmes and court/NGT orders - per-record `source` citations (URLs verified live 2026-07-20 unless marked bot-blocked) carry the accountability; an aggregate description is not an upstream source. Cross-referenced with commitments-delhi.json by id.

note: Active and recent water-restoration programmes and court/NGT orders for NCT Delhi, compiled from sourced reporting and government documents (all URLs verified live 2026-07-20 unless marked bot-blocked). Delhi's restoration ledger is Yamuna-centric: the big money is drain-trapping and STP capacity, not lakefront works - so several entries here are also tracked as dated commitments in commitments-delhi.json (ids cross-referenced). Completed heritage restorations (Nizamuddin baoli, Rajon ki Baoli, Neela Hauz, Purana Qila moat) are kept in the register as existence-proofs that restoration finishes in Delhi when scoped honestly.

projects.scope: Dredging the 57-km Najafgarh drain after a bathymetric survey found ~9.1 million cubic metres of silt; 32 machines deployed including Finnish Watermaster amphibious dredgers. Both a pollution intervention and pre-monsoon flood insurance for west Delhi.
projects.funding_summary: Programme within the Yamuna rejuvenation umbrella (commitment id: mission-sahibi-dredging)

projects.scheme_name: 12 decentralised STPs along the Najafgarh drain
projects.scope: Intercept-and-treat at the sub-drain level along the channel that carries the largest share of Delhi's Yamuna load, instead of trunk diversion.
projects.status: Approved; no public tender/construction milestone yet.

projects.scope: Upgrades toward discharge norms across the STP fleet - answering the NGT record (75% of STPs without disinfection; CAG: effluent of 25 STPs failing DPCC norms).
projects.funding_summary: Rs 403 crore (commitment id: stp-upgrade-403cr); separately Rs 901 crore sanctioned 2025 for +51.5 MGD across 8 plants
projects.status: Sanctioned; per-plant scope not yet public.

projects.scope: Desilting (~60% reported), inflow regulation and a 53 ML storage target for East Delhi's principal lake-park (54 acres, reclaimed from brick-kiln pits in the 1970s).
Restoration push for the horseshoe ox-bow lake (~34 ha, down from ~58), whose catchment carries ~50 t/day of dairy-colony waste next to the Bhalswa landfill - Delhi's hardest lake-restoration test.
projects.status: Announced; prior attempts have failed on inflow control.

projects.scope: Court-mandated EMPs on both sides of the transboundary wetland (water regime, sewage interception, bird habitat) - the only active management framework while the wetland-notification stalemate continues.
projects.status: EMPs notified to NGT; implementation partial; wetland tag still unresolved since INTACH's 2014 petition.

projects.scope: 457 acres of restored floodplain wetlands and grasslands at Wazirabad (Phase I 2005, Phase II active floodplain 2015); DDA credits its park network with ~1 lakh million gallons of recharge since 2021.
projects.status: Operating - the standing proof-of-concept for floodplain restoration.

projects.operator: Aga Khan Trust for Culture (with ASI)
projects.scope: Structural rescue and restoration of the 14th-century spring-fed baoli (2008-2011) within the Nizamuddin renewal; Humayun's Tomb and Sunder Nursery water systems restored across the 2007-2020 core phase.
Conservation of the grandest Mehrauli stepwell (1506), completed 2024-25; holds water seasonally again.
Constructed-wetland treatment train feeding the 6-acre lake below Sanjay Van; restored 2014-2019 after citizen litigation.
Western moat desilted and re-wetted with recycled water; boating restored (2023-24).

court_orders.case: Manoj Misra v Union of India ('Maily Se Nirmal Yamuna')
court_orders.concern: Sewage and industrial load on the 22-km stretch; floodplain encroachment.
court_orders.ruling: The 2015 'Maily Se Nirmal Yamuna Revitalization Plan' judgment; Yamuna Monitoring Committee (Shailaja Chandra + B.S. Sajwan) appointed 2018 - India's longest-running river docket, running 11+ years.

court_orders.case: STP disinfection suo motu (75% of STPs 'not ready to tackle Yamuna stink')
court_orders.concern: 75% of DJB STPs lacking disinfection equipment; faecal coliform in 'treated' effluent.
court_orders.ruling: DJB's sworn status report concedes the disinfection gap - the register's most-cited admission document.

court_orders.case: Sangam Vihar water and sanitation ('A sangam of filth and apathy')
court_orders.concern: Water and sewage absence across Asia's largest unauthorised colony (~1M people).
court_orders.ruling: DJB's reply on record - the rare official account of the tanker-dependent colony's service reality.

court_orders.case: Chhath Puja at the Yamuna refused
court_orders.writ_petition: W.P. before the Delhi High Court
court_orders.concern: Whether ritual bathing could be permitted on the river bank.
court_orders.ruling: Permission denied on pollution grounds - a judicial certification that the river is unfit for the festival that most publicly depends on it. (Source bot-blocks fetchers; opens in a browser.)

court_orders.concern: Transboundary wetland without legal wetland status; encroachment pressure from both states.
court_orders.ruling: NGT ordered Environment Management Plans from both Delhi and Haryana; the wetland notification itself remains stuck - 11 years and counting.

court_orders.writ_petition: NGT proceedings on Delhi's extraction regime
court_orders.concern: India's most over-exploited urban aquifer sits outside CGWA's NOC regime; unregulated private extraction.
court_orders.ruling: Delhi's environment department told the NGT (May 2025) a dedicated borewell policy is being drafted with CGWA - the register tracks its arrival.
